entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The school trip is finally coming to[n]a close...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I never thought I would have the chance[n]to go on one this year as well...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It barely even felt like I was outta the[n]country though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even Yusuke showed up.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm simply glad the storm didn't make[n]its way over here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It may not have been the most exciting[n]trip, but we still had a good time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Honestly though, I'm thankful we didn't[n]have to deal with the storm. They truly[n]are dreadful...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, I saw you guys hanging out[n]all by yourselves last night.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There a problem with that!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, you just looked kinda bummed.[n]That's all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shuddup! And why're you so interested?[n]Something good happen to you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um, no...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aha! So you're in the same position as us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, [fName]. Say something to this[n]lonely girl, won'tcha?
Being alone is okay.
You're the lonely one, Ryuji.
...Are you really lonely?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, it's none of your business! Are girls[n]the only thing that tiny head of yours can[n]think about?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? But we were together all of[n]yesterday!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's right! You're way more desperate[n]than either of us, Ryuji!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No! Stop making things up, Ryuji!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oooh, sounds like I hit the nail on[n]the head?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's enough, you guys.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It felt like this trip went by in a flash.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not sure if I want to go home or stay[n]here longer at this point...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, why don't we shop for souvenirs[n]together before it's time to go?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, count me in!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Allow me to join you as well...[n]Although I have no funds for[n]souvenirs.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're going to be able to get back[n]to Japan... right?
